qualifications: Two retained bodies belong to the same official publisher family and are not independent corroboration.
A live documentation snapshot has no immutable product commit; the Premium launch/version assertion is a publisher statement, not independently verified chain state.
No vault manager address, specific mandate, historical epoch policy, dynamic hedging implementation or actual trade was verified.
The V12 no-pooled-risk description and current Premium vault description apply to different documented user paths; neither is silently used to rewrite the other.
Zero-valued dynamic site counters and marketing claims about safety/audits were not used as evidence.
